response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with strong web/full-stack and some systems-level background, but the profile fundamentally mismatches this role. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, with the past decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. There is no evidence of industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL practices, MQTT, message brokers at industrial scale, or the OT protocol stack the role values, making them a weak fit despite general seniority.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Broad polyglot engineering background with strong testing/TDD craftsmanship and mentoring/teaching track record
Event-driven architecture and geo-data platform experience via GISCollective (Kubernetes, open source)
concerns: Minimal modern C++/STL experience; last professional C++ work was ~2015
No industrial cybersecurity, SDL, or IEC 62443 exposure; no MQTT or OT protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
Career trajectory centers on web/full-stack and AI tooling, not embedded/industrial platform development

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation or IEC 62443 background
